meta.title: Fast Facts: The Science Museum
meta.textType: scanning a timetable and a list of facts

paragraphs: Fast Facts about the Science Museum, posted by Lily. The Explorers visited the science museum on Saturday. Guide Ann showed us around, and we learned a lot. She works there, and she knows every room. The museum is big, and it has four rooms. Many people asked for the facts, so here is a short list. Do you want to find one fact fast? Read the first words of each part.

Opening times. The museum is open from Tuesday to Sunday. It is closed on Monday. On weekdays, it opens at nine o'clock and closes at four o'clock. On Saturday and Sunday, it opens at nine o'clock and closes at five o'clock. The shop is in the hall, and it closes one hour earlier. Weekends are crowded, so a weekday morning is better.

Tours. Guide Ann gives a free tour on every open day. The tours start at ten o'clock, half past eleven, and two o'clock. Each tour takes half an hour. Every tour starts in the hall, next to the shop. A tour has twenty seats. Only a few seats are usually left for the two o'clock tour on Saturday. Guide Ann speaks slowly, and she answers every question.

Tickets. There are four types of ticket. A child ticket costs fifty baht. An adult ticket costs one hundred baht. A family ticket is for two adults and two children, and the price is two hundred baht. A school group pays twenty baht for each child. You can buy a ticket at the desk. Babies do not need a ticket. A ticket is good for the whole day.

The four rooms. The Space Room is the biggest of the four. It has a big model of the sun. The Sea Room has an old wooden surfboard and a small boat. The Sound Room has a big drum, and visitors can hit it. The Water Room has a national map of rivers. It also has a big screen with a video of a river. Mia took her best photo in the Sea Room.

Before you go. Bring a bottle of water. Wear shoes that are good for walking. Ask Guide Ann for a map of the rooms. During national science week, every day is crowded. Which room do you want to see first?
